prompts.enemies:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent enemy sprite atlas for the top-down 2D game Ember Courier. Match the hand-painted, finely textured storybook woodland material and readable broad silhouette of the reference owl; these are menacing shadow creatures, no owl hero in the image.
Make ONE atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows. Full transparent background, no panels, labels, text or marks. Each creature is isolated, whole body, centered in its own cell with 14% empty margins, feet at the same 83% cell-height baseline. Slightly top-down three-quarter view facing down-right. All eight creatures distinct in shape, consistent scale, hard readable silhouette with dark navy body, dusty lilac rim light and small coral-pink dangerous eyes. Not fuzzy or overly transparent.
Row 1 from left: 1 shade: squat hunched ragged shadow imp with two pointed ears and claw hands; 2 runner: slender crouching hare-like shadow with very long rear legs and swept ear fins; 3 brute: massively broad stone-plated ape with two big square fists and cracked slate armor; 4 caster: small cloaked moth mage holding a crooked wooden staff with a violet glass lantern.
Row 2 from left: 5 warder: blue-gray turtle spirit carrying a circular brass-rimmed translucent shield, shell crystal crown; 6 charger: low muscular crimson boar-beast with two swept ivory tusks and spined shoulders; 7 sniper: tall thin heron-like masked scout gripping an unmistakably long brass telescope crossbow, purple scarf; 8 bulwark: heavy faceless sentinel behind a large steel tower shield, thick legs and bronze studs.
No ground, no cast shadow extending between cells, no glow spilling beyond cells, no scenic background. Crisp production game sprites, not a contact sheet of paintings. Preserve exact order and spacing. Wide 2:1 canvas.
prompts.bosses:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent boss sprite atlas for Ember Courier. Use the reference owl only for hand-painted storybook material, soft painterly brush detail with strong crisp silhouettes. Depict original formidable dark woodland boss monsters, no hero.
ONE atlas, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows on true transparent background. Whole body each boss centered in its cell with 12% clear margin, feet at 84% baseline. Consistent slightly top-down three-quarter camera, facing down-right. No text, no panels, no surrounding circles. Bosses should be large, imposing, richly designed but readable at 110px in a mobile game. Slate/navy shadows, brass details, coral magenta hostile glow.
Row 1: 1 night watchman: towering horned raven guardian, heavy ragged indigo cloak, brass street-lantern polearm, broad black-feather wings. 2 ember ram: red-brown armored ram minotaur with huge curved horns and a long burning mane, weighty fists, no weapons obscuring horns. 3 storm astronomer: floating octopus-moth celestial sorcerer with a tall crescent headdress, layered violet robes and five floating blue meteor stones held close to silhouette.
Row 2: 4 thorn regent: huge antlered deer-elk woodland knight in thorny mossy armor with coral-pink thorn crown and branching lance. 5 bell colossus: squat gigantic articulated dark steel golem with weathered bronze bell body, ornate clock face in chest and pillar legs, lavender cracks. 6 leave the entire bottom-right cell completely transparent and empty.
No floor or platforms. No overlapping cells, no borders, no labels. Landscape 3:2 canvas.
prompts.bosses-clean: Edit target: this five-boss sprite atlas. Change only background transparency: remove ALL gray gradient, mist, matte and residual backdrop between and around the five subjects. Make the entire background genuinely alpha-zero transparent, including all of the empty bottom-right cell and negative spaces between limbs and accessories. Preserve all five bosses exactly in their existing cells, pose, colors, sizes and details. Make their bodies fully opaque inside silhouette, preserve fine clean edges. No added scenery or new characters, no other edits. Keep the same 3-column 2-row arrangement and canvas dimensions.
